title: On the Observability and Redundancy of Intelligent Transportation Networks
summary: The safety and reliability of intelligent-transportation-systems (ITS) can be greatly enhanced through adding redundancy in the information-sharing network of the vehicles. In this paper, we first model the mixed traffic of human-driven and autonomous vehicles as a distributed system observability problem over a network of communicating vehicles. We clearly show that a strongly-connected network with minimum n links (with n as network size) is sufficient for the observability of mixed traffic network.
